title: The permission search box filters the cards
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Create Role page, permissions section.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Search permission box.
  2. Type 'invoic'.
  3. See which cards remain.
  4. Clear it.
  5. Type 'timesheets'.
  6. See which cards remain.
  7. Clear it.
custom_expected:
Typing 'invoic' shows only the Invoicing & payments card.

Typing 'timesheets' shows only the Timesheets card.

Clearing the box brings all cards back.
